claims.preamble: A method for displaying a news feed in a social network environment, the method

elements.text: monitoring a plurality of activities in a social network environment
storing the plurality of activities in a database
generating a plurality of news items regarding the activities associated with a user of the social network environment
attaching an informational link associated with at least one of the activities to at least one of the news items, the informational link enabling a viewing user to participate in the same activity
limiting access to the plurality of news items to a predetermined set of viewing users
assigning an order to the plurality of news items
displaying a news feed comprising two or more of the plurality of news items to at least one viewing user of the predetermined set of viewing users

claims.preamble: A system for displaying a news feed in a social network environment, the system

elements.text: a monitoring module configured to monitor a plurality of activities in the social network environment
a database configured to store the plurality of activities
a news item generator configured to generate a plurality of news items regarding the activities associated with a user
a link component configured to attach an informational link to at least one of the news items enabling a viewing user to participate in the same activity
a privacy component configured to limit access to the plurality of news items to a predetermined set of viewing users and to assign an order to the news items
a media generator configured to display a news feed comprising two or more of the plurality of news items to at least one viewing user
